newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli mutual fund index rose 2.8 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Israeli mutual fund index rose 2.8 pct in June.

text.p: The index of Israeli mutual funds rose 2.8 percent in June bringing its first-half cumulative increase to 18.8 percent, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report on Tuesday.

It said the June index rose on the back of strong performances by both equity and bond funds. Forex-linked bond funds led with a 5.2 percent rise following the dollar's strengthening against the shekel in the last part of June.
In the first half of the year, the mutual fund index was led by a 36.1 percent rise in the equity mutual fund index. The index for equity funds that specialise in financial stocks rose 46.2 percent.
The equity fund index tracks the rise of the stock market, where the broadbased General Share index rose 35 percent in the first half. In June alone, the index rose 3.95 percent.

"Most of the month was characterised by a continuation of sharp rises as the bourse broke new nominal records accompanied by higher volume," said Meitav, a broker and fund manager that tracks the mutual fund industry. "In the last third of the month a natural trend towards profit-taking set in."
